In /home/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com, edit content/english/notes/*.md whose basename starts with b or c. Canonical jobs: level_1 Definition/recognize; level_2 Explanation/understand; level_3 Application/use; level_4 Systems/connect (tradeoffs, limits, implications, context); level_5 Generative/create or extend. Each level must do only its assigned job for the same atomic claim. If a level contains an extra independent idea, preserve it by moving it into key_concept after the opening claim. Wikilinks are allowed in any level. Do not change unrelated fields or body content. Preserve all existing user edits and do not commit. Edit files directly, then report files changed and uncertain cases.
